outcome.technical: tools/verify.sh: the live-plan window step moved out of rendered_plan_legs into a new POSIX function live_plan_window DIR. It writes the window at DIR/docs/audit/audit-plan.json, the plan's own record-shaped path, with its shards beside it. It copytrees docs/audit/evidence into DIR/docs/audit/evidence and copies .claude/audit.config.json into DIR/.claude/. As a result _output.project_of_manifest(window) is DIR, checked in lw1. The shape closure now also keeps any phase whose task or phase evidence status or flag (read by _evidence_view.load_evidence with _evidence_io.boundary_for, as render-report.py reads it) no kept phase carries. Without that arm the window lost 'empty-gate', 'tree-unknown' and 'coverage-unknown'. After writing, the step reads the evidence of the full plan and of the window and exits 1 if either reading is absent alone, if the keys or flags chip lists differ, or if any task or phase-own view the window keeps has a different (status, flags). It prints up to 12 of the differing lines on stderr. Validation of the window plan follows. rendered_plan_legs calls live_plan_window "$WORKDIR/live-window" and renders $WORKDIR/live-window/docs/audit/audit-plan.json. The step's comment was rewritten to say only what the code does. It drops the overclaim 'the page still shows each key and status the plan uses' and says a project theme FILE is not copied. tools/gate-parity.py: new private section _live_window_cases, cases lw0-lw4, wired into _cases after _verify_cleanup_cases. It cuts live_plan_window out of the shipped verify.sh with the existing shell_function_text and runs it under dash/sh from REPO against the repo's real plan, with python3 as a shell function calling sys.executable. It then reads both plans through the report's own evidence reader, independently of the step. lw0: the function exists, the leg calls it once and renders the record-shaped path. lw1: exit 0, plan written, project resolves to the window. lw2: zero per-subject disagreements and equal chip lists (628 tasks today). lw3: non-vacuity, files>0, some resolved key, no dangling the full plan lacks. lw4: the step itself exits non-zero naming 'dangling' when the ledger copy is cut; the cut site is counted ==1. All new names are private (_live_window_*, _run_live_window, _evidence_of, _view_word, _window_disagreements), so none takes a lint-shaped public name for prove-gates to count. Results: gate-parity --selftest 125/125, exit 0. The lw cases took 2.8s and 2.6s, two back-to-back runs. The sweep over gate-parity, test__refs and test__output_lints passed 3/3 files with 599 cases, exit 0. prove-gates --selftest 66/66, exit 0. ruff and vermin are clean on gate-parity. The rendered window report was also checked: render-report on the window exits 0 and writes audit-report.html. Class sweep: grep 'render-report.py' tools/verify.sh gives 4 call sites. Line 652 renders the checkout's own plan in place. The one-status and all-parked legs (995, 1016, 1021) render gen-demo-manifest output, which carries its own .git, .claude and evidence/ and was measured to resolve its own ledger (2 files, keys passed/failed/...), so they are left as they are. Dependants: every verify.sh dependant (.gitattributes, ci.yml, derive-phase-gate.py, test__output.py, test__refs.py, affected.py, check-example-pins.py, check-git-pipeline.py) references the script by path. They stay correct because no slice, flag, step label or `run` line changed, only a new function and the leg's body. ci.yml:101's pointer to rendered_plan_legs still resolves. gate-parity dependants that use its public names (floating_runners, image_in_job_names, job_bound_evidence, launcher_contract and the rest) are untouched; only private names were added. prove-gates.py, tests/_harness.py, tests/test__affected_tests.py, tools/sweep-selftests.py, stamp-verification.py, tests/test__runner_collects.py, tests/test_stamp_verification.py and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md were not edited. Their dependants are unaffected. Not edited, out of scope: CONTRIBUTING.md:503-504 ('keeps every phase and task key and status the plan uses') is now backed for evidence statuses too, by the closure arm plus the step's own equality check. tools/check-report-interactive.mjs:766-770 ('a report that DOES carry evidence') is true again. .github/sweep-costs.json does not yet include the lw cases' ~2.7s in tools/gate-parity.py's figure. Edit route: gate-parity.py was edited with Edit. verify.sh's bulk move was done by a python one-off run through Bash, which no gate had refused (asserted anchors, count==1), and the later comment fix used Edit. No plan-gate refusal was met.
